title: Bill Perkins' 'Memory Dividends' Rule Changed How I View Money
alt_title_1: Why Dying With Your Highest Net Worth at 75 Is a Trap
alt_title_2: The Biological Window Rule From 'Die With Zero' Explained
description_hook: Automated saving builds security, but autopilot hoarding past your target misses biological windows money can never reopen. Here is Bill Perkins' Memory Dividends mental model from Die With Zero.

scenes.headline: Peak Net Worth at Peak Frailty?
scenes.stat_label: WHEN MANY SAVERS HIT PEAK NET WORTH
bullets: Millions defer every meaningful trip to an abstract future
Money compounds forever, but physical energy has seasons
scenes.narration: What is the point of reaching your highest net worth at age seventy-five if you skipped every decade your body had the energy to enjoy it?

scenes.headline: Bill Perkins & Memory Dividends
bullets: Financial assets pay cash dividends into your account
Great experiences pay memory dividends every year you live
scenes.narration: In his book Die With Zero, Bill Perkins introduces a mental model called Memory Dividends. Just as index funds pay cash dividends, meaningful experiences pay emotional dividends every time you revisit them.

scenes.headline: Autopilot Hoarding vs Biological Windows
scenes.left_body: Postpone life to 70 -> high capital, low physical stamina
scenes.right_body: Automate base wealth first -> fund decade-specific memories
scenes.narration: Over-hoarding past your automated investing target ignores biological windows. Taking a demanding mountain hike at thirty or traveling with aging parents carries an expiration date money cannot reopen.

scenes.headline: The 5-Year Time-Bucket Protocol
scenes.stat_subtext: Lock automated wealth floor -> invest surplus in peak decades
scenes.narration: Apply the Time-Bucket Rule: automate your baseline wealth investments on payday first, then intentionally fund three experiences over the next five years that belong to your current health window.

scenes.headline: Balance Your Future Floor and Present Life
bullets: Never raid your automated compounding base
Never let fear make you miss non-renewable life seasons
scenes.narration: Smart wealth planning optimizes fulfillment across decades, not just a final bank balance. Otherwise, stop and ask...
